main_measure.name: mean unusual 2-day move on the short side

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, upper half minus lower half of |forecast|

decided_by: t between -2 and 2: neither the confirm nor the reject rule is met (inconclusive rule). No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.786 (below 1), 361 cases (30 needed).
reading: A case is the first short bet (forecast rising in size by at least 2 points from its lowest short level since the last bet) in each 2-bar grid cell from each window's first row, its 2-bar return taken from that bar's close inside the window; the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 2-bar return over all its windows; the t clusters cases by UTC day of the signal bar (with D/(D-1) correction); the upper half is |forecast| strictly above the median, the lower half at or below it.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.786 (below 1), 361 cases (30 needed)
